verdict.rationale: Coinbase publishes the CDP Facilitator fee schedule in its docs: the first 1,000 onchain transactions each month are free, each additional one costs $0.001, and verification is always free. Batch settlement can amortize that cost further, so a merchant can price agentic channels without contacting sales. missing for 10: documentation of who bears onchain network/gas costs on top of the facilitator fee, independent or hands-on corroboration of the published fee schedule

support.subject: As a merchant, the fees for agent-originated transactions are published — I can price agentic channels without asking sales

citations.quote: The first 1,000 onchain Facilitator transactions each month are free, then each additional onchain transaction costs $0.001.
vouchers are verified offchain for free and claimed together, so one onchain transaction can process thousands of payments
